## Moelis Expands Private Capital Advisory Capabilities with Appointment of Zachary Herr


*Herr serves as Managing Director leading the Firm’s LP Secondaries business*


New York


, November 2, 2026


– Moelis & Company (NYSE: MC), a leading global independent investment bank, today announced the expansion of its Private Capital Advisory capabilities, with Managing Director Zachary Herr leading the Firm’s LP Secondaries business. Based in New York, he advises limited partners on secondary transactions and structured liquidity solutions.


Zach has spent his career in the secondary market, advising public and corporate pension plans, endowments and foundations, insurance companies, family offices and asset managers. Prior to Moelis, Zach was a member of the Private Capital Advisory team at Evercore, where he focused on LP-led secondary transactions. Previously, he was a member of Jefferies’ secondaries advisory team and began his investment banking career at Greenhill Cogent, the secondary advisory business of Greenhill & Co.


Matt Wesley, Head of Private Capital Advisory at Moelis, said, “Zach brings deep expertise in advising limited partners and a strong track record of executing complex secondary transactions for sophisticated institutional investors. Zach and our dedicated and growing team of experienced LP secondaries professionals combine extensive market knowledge with the latest analytical tools to deliver differentiated insights and tailored solutions to clients. This expansion further broadens our capabilities and strengthens our ability to provide strategic, independent advice across the private capital ecosystem.”


## About Moelis & Company


Moelis & Company (“Moelis”) is a leading global independent investment bank that provides innovative strategic advice and solutions to a diverse client base, including corporations, governments, and financial sponsors. The Firm assists its clients in achieving their strategic goals by offering comprehensive integrated financial advisory services across all major industry sectors. Moelis’s experienced professionals advise clients on their most critical decisions, including mergers and acquisitions, recapitalizations and restructurings, capital markets transactions, secondary transactions and primary fundraising, and other corporate finance matters. The Firm serves clients from locations across North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. For further information, please visit:[www.moelis.com](http://www.moelis.com/) .
